name: Danish Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

new_statements.citation: Engberg-Pedersen, Elisabeth. 1998. Lærebog i tegnsprogs grammatik, 2. udg. København: Center for Tegnsprog og Tegnstøttet Kommunikation – KC. 170 pp.
new_statements.check: reported by the second reader, not yet confirmed
new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Only one work is listed for this item, and it was snippet-only rather than silent/not-opened, so I spot-checked the previously saved silent DTS sources in the same folder instead: Hansen 2011 MA thesis (30,972 words) has no hits for stress/tryk/betoning/prominen/suprasegment/intensit/duration (only 'prosodic' inside the Brentari 1998 bibliography entry and 'emphasize(d)' in ordinary prose) -- silent confirmed; Engberg-Pedersen 2025 Grammatik ch. 1 : all 12 'tryk' hits are 'udtryk' -- silent confirmed; Lund 2020 : 'tryk' appears only in a report of Johnston (1992) that some Auslan mouth gestures express 'hvad der svarer til tryk i vokalsprog' (~p. 13) and as an abstract example of an element…

sources.citation: Afdeling for Dansk Tegnsprog (Dansk Sprognævn). Bibliographies 'Publikationer' and 'Upublicerede materialer' at dansktegnsprog.dk.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliographic lists only; they name the DTS phonology items that exist (Hansen 2011; Holm & Olsen 1992; Hårdell 2005 'Fonetisk bevægelseslængde i tegnsprog'; Engberg-Pedersen 1998; Engberg-Pedersen, Hansen & Sørensen 1981; Hansen & Engberg-Pedersen 1984; Lieth 1967; Jørgensen 1910).

sources.citation: Engberg-Pedersen, Elisabeth. 2025. Grammatik for dansk tegnsprog: Forord; Kapitel 1 Indledning (online, published 15-03-2025, ongoing). København: Afdeling for Dansk Tegnsprog, Dansk Sprognævn.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Only the foreword and ch. 1 (Indledning, 16 pp.: origin, visual character, simultaneity, loci, terminology) are published so far; foreword says an ideal grammar would also cover 'fonetik'; no hits for tryk/betoning/prosodi/rytme/fonologi.

sources.citation: Lund, Tinne. 2020. Mundbevægelser i dansk tegnsprog: en distributions- og funktionsanalyse af tre mouth gestures. MA thesis, University of Copenhagen (supervisor E. Engberg-Pedersen). 80 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only that some researchers treat mouth gestures as a prosodic/emphatic phenomenon (citing Woll 2001, Johnston et al; p. 67 'prosodiske særheder.. en særlig emfase'); nothing on manual word stress.

sources.citation: Hansen, Julie [= Julie Bakken Jepsen]. 2011. A Linguistic Description of the Phonetics and Phonology of Danish Sign Language. MA thesis, Section for Linguistics, Aarhus University (supervisor W. B. McGregor). 134 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Full phonetics/phonology description (handshape, location, movement, orientation, mouth actions, sign types; author's Danish summary calls it 'den første beskrivelse af dansk tegnsprogs fonetik og fonologi'); zero occurrences of 'stress', 'prominence', 'suprasegmental', 'duration', 'intensity'; movement section (3.1.4, pp. 51-55) treats path/internal movement and repetition only; no suprasegmental/prosodic level is described or flagged as excluded.
